title: Connecticut SBLR — Decision No. 5310 — Town of East Windsor

DECISION AND CERTIFICATION
OF REPRESENTATIVE
Pursuant to the Agreement for Consent Election dated February 5, 2024, an election by
secret ballot was conducted on February 22, 2024, at the East Windsor Town Hall Annex, East
Windsor, Connecticut, under the supervision of the Connecticut State Board of Labor Relations.
The tally of ballots was as follows:
Number of Ballots Cast . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Number of Ballots Cast………………………………………………………………………… 4
Number of Ballots Counted……………………………………………………………………. 4
Number of Votes IN FAVOR of representation by:
Council 4, AFSCME, AFL-CIO……………..……………………………………….. 1
Teamsters Local 671……………………………………….………………………… 3
Neither …………………………………………………………………………………….0
Number of Blank Ballots ………………………………………………………………………. 0
Number of Void Ballots ………………………………………………………………………. 0
Number of Challenged Ballots ……………………………………………………………… 0
Copies of the Report Upon Secret Ballot were duly served upon all parties. No
exceptions to the report or objections to the election were filed with the Board.
Since the parties have agreed that the unit is appropriate, the Board’s approval of the
action herein is not to be taken as a precedent as to what unit it would find appropriate in the
absence of such an agreement.
Therefore, by virtue of and pursuant to the power vested in the Connecticut State Board
of Labor Relations by the Municipal Employee Relations Act, it is hereby,
CERTIFIED, that Teamsters Local 671 has been selected as the representative for the
purposes of collective bargaining by the majority of Town of East Windsor employees in a unit
classified as all full time and part time dispatchers, excluding all other employees, and that said

Teamsters Local 671 is the exclusive representative of all said employees for the purposes of
collective bargaining with respect to wages, hours and other conditions of employment.
CONNECTICUT STATE BOARD OF LABOR RELATIONS
BY Barbara Collins, Board Member
